routes.title: Some Couples Have No Responsible Adult - Dance Floor Version
routes.truth: The most taggable couples are not always one sensible person and one chaotic person; sometimes both become the same harmless bad idea.
routes.obstacle: A public almost-awkward moment could make her feel too much or exposed.
routes.aachu_role: Starts the expressive dance-floor moment, gets briefly caught or embarrassed, then turns his rescue into a shared bit.
routes.zuv_role: Notices the snag, frees it on beat, then joins instead of correcting or rescuing from outside.
routes.proof: Dupatta or bangle catches mid-step; his hand frees it like choreography; she drags him into the ridiculous step; both end up off-beat together.
routes.reversal: What could have become embarrassment becomes a two-person conspiracy.

routes.title: He Didn't Lower Her Volume
routes.truth: The right person does not make your aliveness smaller in public.
routes.obstacle: She catches herself being too much around people.
routes.proof: She pauses mid-story; he laughs first and asks her to continue.
routes.repair_note: Too close to rejected public-spark and Aachu-quirk/Zuv-support lanes unless made more reciprocal.

routes.title: The Chalo Face
routes.truth: Some couples have an exit language no one else can hear.
routes.obstacle: Both are socially done at a crowded function but cannot be rude.
routes.proof: One look across the room starts the exit plan; each rescues the other from one conversation.
routes.repair_note: Strong, but overlaps mood-reading/subtitle memory unless staged as mutual escape rather than him decoding her.

routes.title: Tailor Shop Safety-Pin Storm
routes.truth: Some love notices discomfort under the sparkle.
routes.proof: He sees the flinch, handles pins respectfully, and she fixes his collar back.
routes.repair_note: Beautiful desi texture, but more private and less instantly taggable than the dance-floor route.

routes.title: Monsoon Footpath Geometry
routes.truth: Love is learning to share the wet edge.
routes.obstacle: Sudden rain makes care physically visible.
routes.proof: He tilts the umbrella; she recenters it; both get drenched by the awning.
routes.repair_note: Strong visual reversal, but wet-shoulder care risks perfect-husband drift unless the mutual correction lands.

routes.title: Balcony Rain Drill
routes.truth: Some couples become a team only after the clouds have already started.
routes.obstacle: Sudden rain threatens drying clothes and domestic calm.
routes.proof: Both sprint to save laundry, sacrifice one sock, and laugh at the pile.
routes.repair_note: Relatable, but the emotional obstacle is smaller and may read like a domestic sketch.

routes.title: She Said It Was Fine. The Room Disagreed.
routes.truth: Some people do not ask for softness; they leave clues.
routes.obstacle: Her words say fine, but the room reveals the feeling.
routes.proof: Objects and hands confess what her face refuses to say.
routes.repair_note: Strong hook, but close to old 'mujhe kuch nahi hua' and fight-repair surfaces.
